title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP


Experiência Profissional


Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório


Requisitos


  • Excelente conhecimento em desenvolvimento ABAP no S/4, incluindo Steampunk e conceitos de SAP Clean Core
  • Conhecimento em criação de CDS Views , ODATA & REST e integração orientada por APIs .
  • Experiência em ABAP on S/4 HANA de 3 a 4 anos – CDS , AMDP (ABAP Managed Database Procedures) e table functions , RAP Framework (RESTful Application Programming)
  • Habilidades de integração no S/4 usando Rest API e SProxy
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms
  • Conhecimento do processo SolMan Charm
  • Conhecimento em pesquisa de SAP Notes como parte do tratamento de defeitos. Registrar OSS-cases na SAP e instalar SAP Notes
  • Conhecimento em instalação e/ou ativação de versões de países do S/4
  • Conhecimento em instalação de namespaces para integração com sistemas legais
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado para escrita e conversação - Obrigatório
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Brasil
  • Conhecimento em tributação do Peru e do Chile será um diferencial
  • Espanhol será um diferencial


Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting‑edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are looking for a talented and motivated UX/UI Designer to join our UX team. If you are proactive, organized, and passionate about creating exceptional user experiences, we want to meet you!


Responsibilities

• UX Research: Conduct research using techniques such as desk research, user and stakeholder interviews, benchmarking, surveys, persona creation, user journeys, empathy maps, user flows, sitemaps, and more.

• Perform tests such as user testing, shadowing, field research, tree testing, and A/B testing to generate valuable insights during project discovery.

• UI Design: Develop low-, medium-, and high-fidelity prototypes, creating visually appealing and functional interfaces aligned with user and project needs.


Requirements

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UX and UI projects.

• Intermediate English for conversation is required.

• Spanish is considered a plus.


Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Colaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Front-End Engineering Technical Lead - (Fintech & Payments | Crypto) - Gowd
description:
We are looking for a Front-End Engineering Technical Lead  to own the design, architecture, and implementation of our user interfaces  across web and mobile experiences. This is a hands-on role  with strong emphasis on coding, design quality, and technical decision-making , not just coordination.


You will work directly with Product Management and UI/UX  to translate product vision into scalable, performant, and intuitive user interfaces, while setting engineering standards and best practices for the front-end stack. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys building, shaping architecture, while staying deeply involved in implementation.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadershiop & Architecture

  • Own the front-end architecture  for web and mobile applications.
  • Make technical design decisions  around frameworks, components, state management, performance, and scalability.
  • Define and enforce front-end best practices , coding standards, and UI consistency.


Hands-On Development

  • Design and implement complex, high-quality UI components.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces.
  • Lead by example through significant individual code contributions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product  to refine requirements and scope.
  • Work directly with UI/UX  to ensure design fidelity and usability.
  • Translate product and design concepts into technical solutions.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of front-end engineering experience , with at least 1+ years in a technical leadership role
  • Strong experience with Angular  (required).
  • Experience with Flutter and/or React  (required).
  • Proven track record of building production-grade, scalable UI applications.
  • Strong understanding of:

Component-based architectures;

Responsive and accessible design;

Performance optimization;

  • Experience working closely with UI/UX.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lit (LIT)  or Web Components.
  • Previous experience in fintech.
  • Knowledge of security best practices for front-end applications.


What We Offer, Why Join Gowd?

  • High ownership and technical influence.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote-first work model with flexibility and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to shape the user experience of a growing fintech platform with presence in Brasil and Mexico.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in payments, crypto, and Web3 innovation.
  • Build real-world, high-impact financial products.

title: Cientista de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Cientista de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

  • Programação;
  • Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

  • Python;
  • PySpark;
  • SQL.

Ferramentas:

Big Data:

  • HUE;
  • Hive;
  • Spark (SparkML);
  • NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

  • DB2;
  • MySQL;
  • Oracle;
  • Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).
  • Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)
  • Versionamento de código (Git)

Dashboards:

  • Spotfire;
  • Power BI.

Ciência de Dados

  • Manipulação de Dados;
  • Visualização de Dados;
  • Estatística;
  • Modelagem Preditiva;
  • Inteligência Artificial
  • IA Generativa
  • Machine Learning.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.


Estamos a procura de Projetistas de Produto Pleno e Sênior.


Áreas:

  • Body in White;
  • Closures;
  • Internal Trims;
  • External Trims;


Formação:

  • Engenharia mecânica, Mecatrônica ou Produção.
  • Técnico em Mecânica ou Mecatrônica.


Requisitos:

  • 5 anos ou mais de experiência como projetista de desenvolvimento de produto nas áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de peças plásticas;
  • Conhecimento e domínio dos softwares CATIA V5 ou Unigraphics NX (testes poderão ser aplicados durante o processo);
  • Oportunidades para desenvolvimento de atividades de forma remota / híbrida e presencial.
  • Desejável: Inglês Avançado (Não Mandatório);

title: Projetista de Produto
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

title: Suporte Python Tech Ops
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Solucionar problemas de suporte e solicitações técnicas relacionadas a sistemas de produção.
  • Conduzir análises técnicas aprofundadas de incidentes, realizando investigações.
  • Monitorar, relatar e solucionar problemas de pipeline de dados e sistemas de back-end
  • Analisar fluxos de trabalho e criar relatórios de defeitos / falhas detalhados

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Proficiência em depuração de problemas técnicos;
  • Proficiente em SQL e familiarizado com ecossistemas de Big Data como Cassandra, Flink, Kafka e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento de scripts com Python ou linguagens similares para automatizar tarefas e solucionar problemas de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência em depuração de API Requests e problemas de respostas usando ferramentas como Charles, logs de rede ou métodos semelhantes;
  • Experiência com implementação e administração de ferramentas de monitoramento, registro e telemetria (por exemplo, Splunk, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Ingles avançado para escrita e conversação (obrigatório, projeto internacional).

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Salesforce
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Components.


  • Customize Salesforce objects, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.


  • Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, Lightning Web Components (LWC).


  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs.


  • Perform data migration and ensure data integrity.


  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.


  • Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning.


  • Stay updated with Salesforce releases and best practices.


Required Skills:


  • Strong experience in Apex, Visualforce, LWC, SOQL, SOSL.


  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration and customization.


  • Knowledge of Salesforce security model, sharing rules, and governor limits.


  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (API, middleware tools like MuleSoft).


  • Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools (Change Sets, ANT, SFDX).


  • Good understanding of Agile methodology.

title: Google Ads Portfolio Manager MCC & Billing
description:
Esta função é destinada a profissionais que gerenciam portfólios de contas Google Ads com foco em controle de estrutura, faturamento e visibilidade financeira dentro de ambientes MCC.

Como Google Ads Portfolio Manager, você será responsável por supervisionar um conjunto de contas organizadas em MCCs, garantindo que estruturas de billing, acessos e fluxos financeiros estejam corretos e alinhados aos padrões da agência. O papel combina gestão operacional com responsabilidade financeira em escala.

Você atuará em parceria com equipes de paid media, operações e finanças para acompanhar investimentos, validar configurações de faturamento, apoiar reconciliação de faturas e manter transparência em todo o portfólio. A função exige organização, precisão e experiência em ambientes multi-conta.

As responsabilidades incluem gestão de portfólio em MCCs, controle de billing, monitoramento de gastos, alinhamento com equipes internas e manutenção da integridade operacional das contas.

O que esta posição oferece:

Gestão de portfólio de contas Google Ads em MCC

Responsabilidade sobre billing e controle financeiro

Colaboração direta com equipes de finanças e operações

Ambiente remoto com flexibilidade

Foco em governança e clareza operacional

Exposição a estruturas complexas e múltiplos clientes

Caminho de crescimento para cargos seniores de operações

  • Este cargo é ideal para profissionais detalhistas, orientados a processos e confortáveis em gerenciar billing e estruturas MCC dentro de um ambiente de agência.

title: Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management)
description:
Engenheiro OTM (Oracle Transportation Management) Sr.


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato: Longo Prazo
  • Horário de Trabalho: UTC – Sede em Dallas/TX/EUA
  • Modalidade: 100% remoto
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou via Cooperativa
  • Taxa Hora: A ser negociado


Descrição da Vaga:


Profissional responsável por projetar, implementar, manter e dar suporte às soluções Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), garantindo eficiência operacional, confiabilidade, integração com outros sistemas e aderência às melhores práticas de logística, transporte e cadeia de suprimentos. Este profissional atuará como referência técnica para o ambiente OTM, apoiando equipes de negócios, operações e técnicas.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Configurar, aprimorar e ajustar tecnicamente o Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Definir e implementar soluções alinhadas às estratégias de logística, transporte e distribuição.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos, desenho de processos e documentação técnica e funcional.
  • Executar troubleshooting, análise de performance e resolução de incidentes em ambientes OTM.
  • Apoiar processos de implementação, melhoria contínua e projetos de evolução.
  • Trabalhar em integrações com ERP, WMS, TMS externos e outras plataformas corporativas.
  • Garantir segurança, governança, qualidade de dados e melhores práticas de arquitetura.
  • Apoiar equipes de negócios, operações e TI no uso correto do OTM.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro OTM ou em projetos com Oracle Transportation Management.
  • Forte conhecimento nos módulos de planejamento, execução, tarifação e visibilidade de transporte.
  • Experiência em integração do OTM com outros sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência em desenho de soluções e análise funcional de processos logísticos.
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, suporte e sustentação do OTM.
  • Conhecimento em SFTP, Web Services, APIs, XML, SQL ou tecnologias de integração relacionadas.
  • Idioma: Inglês avançado é obrigatório

title: Application Architect - Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Title: Applications Architect

Competency Level: C5


Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Applications Architect with strong expertise in application modernization and Azure PaaS platforms. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of application architecture, cloud migration strategies, and modern hosting approaches, along with proven leadership experience guiding and managing technical teams.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead application architecture, design, and modernization initiatives for enterprise-scale applications.
  • Modernize and migrate applications from on-premises or legacy platforms to Azure PaaS .
  • Host, configure, and optimize applications on IIS and Azure services.
  • Design and implement solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Instances .
  • Analyze application architecture, dependencies, and integrations to define optimal migration pathways.
  • Perform application performance assessments before and after migration .
  • Containerize web applications and services, and manage deployment on Kubernetes.
  • Design Azure Landing Zones and define the Azure target-state solution architecture based on customer infrastructure landscapes.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data Platform, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure cloud adoption aligns with best practices.
  • Ensure solutions align with Azure strategy, business objectives, application and infrastructure requirements, and overall value realization.
  • Lead and technically guide teams of 5+ members , providing mentorship and architectural direction.
  • Work closely with internal teams, customers, and project managers to gather requirements and propose effective migration solutions.
  • Prepare and deliver solution architectures, technical documentation, and presentations to stakeholders.


Primary Skills & Technical Expertise

  • 13+ years of hands-on experience in application development and modernization .
  • Strong web application development experience.
  • Hands-on experience developing and hosting applications on Azure PaaS .
  • Expertise in application hosting, configuration, and optimization on Azure.
  • Strong understanding of database connectivity and configuration .
  • Proven ability to analyze application dependencies and integration points.
  • Experience with containerization of frontend applications and web services.
  • In-depth knowledge of hosting and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes / AKS .
  • Strong understanding of application migration scenarios, strategies, and pathways.


Secondary Skills

  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to define migration requirements.
  • Troubleshooting experience with Azure PaaS services.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of containerization and AKS operations.


Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Positive attitude with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage and lead customer discussions and technical calls.
  • Strong presentation skills for solution and architecture proposals.
  • Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Technology Stack / Languages

  • .NET
  • Java
  • Angular / React
  • Python

title: Estagiário
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Somos uma empresa atuante na construção de casas populares (Minha Casa Minha Vida) , regularização de imóveis e desenvolvimento de loteamentos residenciais , oferecendo soluções completas em engenharia, planejamento urbano e organização técnica para viabilizar moradia acessível.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a) para atuar no modelo híbrido , em Belém/PA , apoiando a equipe técnica e administrativa da empresa.

A vaga é ideal para quem possui conhecimento básico em AutoCAD , interesse na área de construção civil e deseja aprender, na prática, sobre projetos, documentação técnica e rotina administrativa de obras e loteamentos.

Responsabilidades
  • Apoio na elaboração e ajustes de projetos em AutoCAD ;
  • Auxílio na confecção de memoriais descritivos , mapas de localização e documentos técnicos;
  • Organização e atualização de planilhas de obra e controles administrativos;
  • Suporte às demandas administrativas da equipe técnica;
  • Organização de documentos e apoio em processos de regularização e obras;
  • Apoio presencial quando necessário, conforme rotina da equipe.
Requisitos
  • Conhecimento básico em AutoCAD ;
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (Excel e Word);
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em Belém/PA ;
  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver profissionalmente.
Diferenciais
  • Interesse por construção civil, habitação popular e urbanismo;
  • Noções iniciais de documentação técnica e obras;
  • Proatividade e comprometimento.
Informações da Vaga
  • Cargo: Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a)
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
  • Local: Belém – PA
  • Tipo de vaga: Meio período
  • Bolsa auxílio inicial: R$ 700,00
  • Possibilidade de aumento conforme desempenho e evolução técnica

title: Associado de operações
description:
Operations Associate | Remote (Brazil) | U.S. Market


Na Blue Dot BPO , apoiamos empresas norte-americanas na construção de operações eficientes, escaláveis e orientadas a resultados. Buscamos um(a) Operations Associate analítico(a), organizado(a) e com forte senso de ownership para apoiar e otimizar processos operacionais críticos em um ambiente remoto e dinâmico, atuando diretamente com o mercado dos EUA.

Esta é uma posição estratégica para profissionais que desejam crescer em operações, projetos e análise de negócios, trabalhando de forma próxima à liderança e a times multifuncionais.



O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração fixa de R$4.000 reais
  • Contrato full-time (Brasil)
  • 100% remoto, atuando diretamente com o mercado dos EUA
  • Horário das 13h às 22h (BRT)
  • Contrato de longo prazo com possibilidade de crescimento
  • Ambiente internacional, multicultural e orientado à performance



Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a análise e otimização de processos operacionais entre diferentes áreas
  • Mapear fluxos de trabalho, identificar gargalos e propor melhorias (SOPs e boas práticas)
  • Apoiar e/ou gerenciar projetos interdepartamentais, garantindo prazos e entregas
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre operações, liderança e stakeholders
  • Criar relatórios operacionais, análises de dados e indicadores de performance (KPIs)
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica com dados e insights acionáveis
  • Garantir organização de documentação, processos e comunicação interna



O que buscamos

  • Graduação completa (Administração, Gestão, Engenharia, áreas correlatas)
  • Inglês fluente (uso diário com equipes e stakeholders dos EUA)
  • Experiência prévia em operações, análise de negócios ou coordenação de projetos
  • Experiência trabalhando com empresas sediadas nos Estados Unidos
  • Forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes
  • Domínio avançado de Microsoft Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em ambiente remoto
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de lidar com múltiplos stakeholders



Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Asana, Trello, ClickUp)

  • Vivência em startups ou ambientes de ritmo acelerado


Trabalhe diretamente com o mercado dos EUA e desenvolva sua carreira em um ambiente que valoriza organização, autonomia e entrega de resultados .

title: Gerente Distrital de Vendas
description:
Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia;
  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).


Informações adicionais:


Benefícios:


  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR


Buscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!


SOMOS LEGRAND


Há mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer  to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings
  • Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce
  • Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow
  • Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed
  • Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions
  • Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process
  • Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure
  • Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions
  • Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)
  • Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic
  • Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)
  • Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility
  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)
  • Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules
  • Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding
  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization
  • Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Portuguese Cardiologist Medical Students / Doctors
description:
Company Description

DeepLLMData specializes in empowering frontier models with human-generated expert data. Our expertise spans coding SFT, RLHF, STEM fields, PhD-level research, and domain-specific knowledge. We offer image and video annotators, as well as comprehensive data provisioning services for image and video-based projects. By using our precise and expert-guided data, we help innovate and advance AI systems.


Role Description

This is a remote, contract-based role for Portuguese-speaking Cardiologist Medical Students or Doctors. In this position, you will contribute to generating, reviewing, and enriching medical data specific to cardiology. Your tasks will involve utilizing your expertise in specialized areas of medicine, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of data across different cardiology subfields.


Qualifications

  • Specialized knowledge in Cardiology and related disciplines
  • Portuguese language proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking)
  • Attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality

title: Gynecologist - with Portuguese Language
description:
Company Description

DeepLLMData specializes in providing expert human-annotated data to enhance frontier machine learning models. Our expertise includes coding SFT and RLHF, as well as services from domain-specific experts in areas such as medicine, STEM, and mathematics. We also offer image and video annotation along with provisioning high-quality image and video datasets. Our commitment is to deliver precise and high-value data solutions for innovative AI applications.


We are looking for Gynecology specialization for LLM are looking for:

  • Gynecology's Medical Students (Years 4–6)
  • Medical Interns / Early Residents
  • Gynecologist

Work:

  • Working with LLM for Gynecology specific data preparation


  • QA of clinical content (EHR, RX, diagnostics, research notes)

Requirements:

  • Gynecologist
  • Portuguese + good English comprehension
  • Accuracy, attention to detail
  • No prior AI experience needed

Type of Work:

  • Remote
  • Flexible hours (5–20 hrs/week)
  • Freelance / Independent contractor

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.


Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Pricing or Computer Vision) 100% Remote, Fluent English (required)


Brazil-based | PJ Contract | Long-term


We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team on a long-term, fully remote PJ contract . This is a global environment with international stakeholders, and fluency in English is mandatory , as all communication and interviews are conducted in English.


This role is open to Brazil-based professionals with strong experience in Pricing/Optimization or Computer Vision , who are passionate about building and deploying production-grade ML systems that drive real business impact.


What you’ll do


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems
  • Own key components of ML systems, influencing technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Develop clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to generate actionable insights
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies to build robust and scalable models
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders
  • Mentor junior team members and help grow domain expertise within the team
  • Contribute to the company’s technical leadership through research, publications, or patents


Minimum Requirements


  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong understanding of ML best practices (feature engineering, A/B testing, experiment design, training & serving pipelines)
  • Hands-on experience with ML algorithms and techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization)
  • Experience in at least one of the following domains:
  • Pricing / price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection & authentication, or marketing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with scientific and ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Solid data engineering experience with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with Big Data tools such as Spark, Kafka, Apache Beam
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world business problems, preferably in retail or e-commerce
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines
  • Strong sense of ownership, impact-driven mindset, and passion for high-quality ML solutions


Why join us

  • 100% remote work (Brazil-based)
  • Long-term PJ contract
  • Flexible working hours aligned with Brazil time
  • Opportunity to work on impactful ML systems in a global environment
  • Strong technical ownership and growth opportunities

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Busca & Recomendação
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Staff Software Engineer para atuar como referência técnica no time de busca e recomendação , contexto esse de alta criticidade. Sendo responsável por construir e evoluir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alto desempenho .

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução arquitetural , na tomada de decisões tecnológicas , na elevação contínua da qualidade técnica e na condução de iniciativas de alto impacto para o negócio .


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time , guiando decisões arquiteturais e garantindo excelência em engenharia;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir sistemas de larga escala utilizando Go (Golang) e .NET;
  • Arquitetar e implementar soluções em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , com foco em automação, escalabilidade, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais , garantindo performance e consistência;
  • Implementar e evoluir práticas de observabilidade , utilizando Datadog, Grafana e ferramentas correlatas;
  • Liderar iniciativas de CI/CD , qualidade de código e engenharia de confiabilidade (SRE);
  • Mentorar engenheiros, promovendo boas práticas, padrões técnicos e crescimento do time .


O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Experiência com ElasticSearch , incluindo tuning e otimização de motores de busca para e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado a relevância e ranking , do motor de busca;
  • Domínio em .NET e/ou Golang;
  • Forte experiência com GCP e infraestrutura em cloud;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de produtores e consumidores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes , incluindo deploy, escalabilidade e operação de aplicações conteinerizadas;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas modernas de engenharia de software;
  • Noções ou experiência em Ciência de Dados;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de busca em e-commerce;
  • Vivência com experimentação , métricas e testes A/B para validação de hipóteses e comprovação de conceitos.


O que esperamos do seu perfil

  • Mentalidade de dono , com visão sistêmica e foco em longo prazo;
  • Capacidade de influenciar tecnicamente e elevar a barra do time;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva , inclusive com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Perfil colaborativo , pragmático e orientado a resultados.

title: Content Manager
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re Nooro - a fast-growing app company operating alongside a highly profitable eCommerce business, doing over $100M per year. 


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Content Manager to own communication with our network of content creators and work closely with our creative strategists to keep content production organized, consistent, and moving fast.

This role sits at the center of our creative operation. You’ll manage creator communication, timelines, and expectations; coordinate with strategists; and ensure all content (including B-roll) is delivered, organized, and easy to use.


You’ll also be responsible for keeping our creative systems clean and structured across Asana, Google Drive, and (over time) tools like Frame.io and Airtable. You don’t need to be a creator yourself, but you must have strong taste - an intuitive sense for what makes content good, usable, and on-brand.


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


We’re looking for someone empathetic, clear, and assertive - able to build strong relationships with creators while confidently enforcing standards and deadlines. You should be highly organized, reliable, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities move quickly.


This is a role with real growth potential for someone who wants to evolve into a senior creative operations or leadership position. We pay above market, value ownership, and reward people who grow with the company.


If you’re sharp, dependable, and excited to help organize and scale a serious creative engine, we’d love to hear from you.


WHAT WE EXPECT?


  • Reliability -  You are hardworking, independent, and operate well under pressure.
  • Fast Learner -  You possess the intelligence to adapt to our dynamic environment instantly.
  • Assertive Communication -  You manage creators with empathy, but you enforce our rules without exception.
  • Operational Excellence -  You keep our systems (Asana, GDrive, Airtable) air-tight, and the production moving 24/7.
  • High Output -  We work long hours because we scale fast. No “free riders” or 9-to-5 mindsets.


WHAT WE OFFER?


  • Above-market pay -  Above-market pay for those who deliver results.
  • Unlimited growth -  We invest in our team’s mental, professional, and financial expansion.
  • High-performance culture -  A direct, driven group of individuals that want to grow.

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS .
  • Ensure clean, scalable, and well-documented code.


Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Write automated tests to guarantee quality and stability.
  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).
  • Communicate requirements and delivery status clearly.


Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements


  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer
description:
About You

You are a senior full stack engineer who enjoy owning features end-to-end, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and shaping delivery processes rather than simply executing tasks. You are comfortable working with legacy systems while helping modernize platforms that support high-visibility sports and real-time event management applications.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core and C# for building web applications and data APIs.
  • Proven experience using Entity Framework Core and LINQ for data access and business logic.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server , including writing complex queries and working with relational data models.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript , jQuery , and frontend development using MVC / Razor views .
  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs .
  • Exposure to real-time or event-driven features (e.g., SignalR or similar patterns).
  • General cloud literacy with exposure to Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Azure AD.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern version control workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of Web Components (e.g., Shadow DOM / Light DOM).
  • Excellent communication skills, able to participate in weekly client-facing meetings with US-based teams.
  • English proficiency is required, as you will be working directly with US clients in the sports industry.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining ASP.NET Core web applications and data APIs that support real-time sports and event management platforms.
  • Implementing backend logic using C#, Entity Framework Core, and LINQ, ensuring clean, maintainable code.
  • Developing frontend functionality using JavaScript, jQuery, Web Components, and Razor / MVC.
  • Writing and maintaining SQL Server queries to support application features.
  • Integrating with Azure services such as Blob Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Azure AD as part of the platform ecosystem.
  • Participating in code reviews and contributing to continuous improvement of development practices.
  • Owning the quality of your deliverables by writing unit and end-to-end tests for critical business logic.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in both development and production environments.
  • Acting as a trusted senior contributor, helping to scale processes, shape workflows, and ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects.


Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
  • Proven experience developing frontend features using JavaScript, jQuery, and Razor / MVC views.
  • Senior delivery mindset with strong English communication skills.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

title: Analista de Tools
description:
Analista de Tools Pleno


Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


• Implementar, administrar e dar suporte a ambientes de Zabbix, Grafana e Ansible, garantindo a correta coleta, análise e visualização de métricas.

• Desenvolver e manter integrações entre sistemas de monitoramento, automação e plataformas corporativas, seguindo padrões definidos pelo time.

• Apoiar a administração e otimização de bancos de dados PostgreSQL, incluindo rotinas básicas de tuning, replicação e manutenção.

• Monitorar logs e eventos relevantes utilizando Syslog, Elastic Stack ou ferramentas equivalentes.

• Atuar na resolução de incidentes relacionados às ferramentas de monitoramento e automação.

• Contribuir com melhorias contínuas, automações e padronizações que elevem a maturidade operacional do ambiente.

• Produzir e manter documentação técnica das soluções implementadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência em ambientes de infraestrutura, monitoramento ou operações.

• Conhecimento em protocolos de rede e comunicação (SNMP, ICMP, HTTP, SSH, API REST, Syslog).

• Experiência prática com Zabbix, Grafana, Ansible, PostgreSQL e Linux.

• Noções de arquiteturas distribuídas e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

• Experiência com integrações via API e troubleshooting em ambientes híbridos.

• Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em ambientes Azure.

• Familiaridade com versionamento de código e automações utilizando Git/GitLab CI/CD.

Certificações desejáveis:

• Zabbix Certified User (ZCU) ou Zabbix Certified Specialist (ZCS)

• Certificações iniciais em Cloud (Azure Fundamentals ou similares)

• LPIC-1 ou equivalente

Diferenciais Desejáveis

• Experiência ou contato com Elastic Stack, NetBox, APM ou ferramentas correlatas.

• Conhecimentos em Python, Bash ou JavaScript para automações e scripts.

• Atuação prévia em times de Tools, NOC, SRE ou DevOps.

• Interesse em automação, confiabilidade e melhoria contínua (Kaizen).


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Principal Backend Engineer (Typescript)
description:
Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Typescript and strong experience designing and evolving backend architectures. You will be expected to work with a high level of autonomy, driving technical decisions, defining best practices, and leading complex projects from design to deployment. This is not a managerial position, but you will act as a technical reference for the team, mentoring others and setting high standards for code quality, scalability, and DevOps practices.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of backend architectures, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Define and implement engineering best practices and frameworks to uplift our quality and resiliency.
  • Take ownership of complex technical initiatives, from planning and estimation to delivery.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Guide and mentor other engineers, sharing knowledge and reviewing code to ensure technical excellence.
  • Champion CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and DevOps best practices.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement in our systems and propose architectural changes.


Technology Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a backend developer.
  • Deep expertise in Typescript and NestJS, with solid knowledge of relational and non‑relational databases.
  • Hands‑on experience designing and deploying microservices and event‑driven systems.
  • 3+ years running workloads on AWS Lambda and related services (DynamoDB, RDS), with strong understanding of cloud architecture patterns.
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles, separation of concerns, and software design patterns.
  • Solid experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code and monitoring practices is a plus.
  • Experience with Python is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to work independently and drive projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong project management mindset and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others grow.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.
