title: Senior SAP ABAP Developer
description:
Senior SAP ABAP Developer

Client Location: USA (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Month Contract


GlobalSource IT is working with a direct client that is seeking a Senior SAP ABAP Developer to join their team. This role is open due to the recent retirement of a long-tenured ABAP developer, and the client is looking to bring on an experienced contractor to help support and enhance their SAP environment.


This is a fully remote, long-term contract (12+ months) supporting a highly customized SAP ECC 6.0 landscape. The successful candidate must be comfortable remaining in ECC for the foreseeable future, as the client is not yet moving to S/4HANA.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and support ABAP solutions within a highly customized ECC 6.0 environment
  • Provide procurement-related ABAP development and enhancements
  • Support system integrations, including inbound and outbound interfaces
  • Perform bug fixes, minor enhancements, table updates, and occasional production support
  • Collaborate with functional teams and external vendors during upcoming integration efforts
  • Adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of assigned work with minimal oversight


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong, well-rounded SAP ABAP development experience in ECC 6.0
  • Procurement-related development experience (MM/P2P focus)
  • Integration experience (Coupa integration strongly preferred)
  • Solid experience with IDOCs and EDI
  • Working knowledge of SmartForms and SAPScript
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, highly customized environment
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work CST business hours


Upcoming Projects:

  • Major global Coupa implementation planned later this year
  • Coupa will replace Ariba globally, beginning in North America
  • Prior to Coupa ramp-up, work will focus on:
  • Minor enhancements
  • Bug fixes
  • Table updates
  • Occasional production support


Additional Requirements:

  • Must be comfortable working in SAP ECC for 12–18+ months without immediate S/4HANA exposure
  • Adaptable, autonomous, and able to “wear multiple hats” in a lean team environment

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Atividades:

Desenvolver soluções backend robustas, escaláveis e seguras (preferencialmente em Go), atuando no coração da nossa plataforma.

Participar da evolução da arquitetura dos nossos serviços, propondo melhorias e trazendo visão de longo prazo.

Colaborar ativamente na construção de processos técnicos, padrões, boas práticas e automações.

Investigar problemas complexos, propor soluções inteligentes e antecipar riscos e impactos.

Trabalhar lado a lado com Produto, Design e demais áreas para entregar soluções de alto impacto para médicos, pacientes e parceiros.

Garantir qualidade nas entregas, com testes, documentação e preocupação com performance.

Contribuir com ideias, discussões técnicas e revisões de código, elevando o nível técnico do time.

Apoiar a cultura de engenharia com práticas modernas (CI/CD, observabilidade, segurança, escalabilidade).

Aqui você terá autonomia, espaço para construir e liberdade para experimentar. É uma vaga para quem gosta de deixar legado técnico.


Requisitos da vaga:

Cloud & Infraestrutura


Experiência com AWS e boa compreensão de ambientes escaláveis, seguros e de alta disponibilidade.

Vivência com Kubernetes, API Gateway e monitoramento/observabilidade.

Desenvolvimento Backend


Forte conhecimento em Go (ou abertura para aprender rapidamente).

Experiência em criação e manutenção de APIs performáticas e resilientes.

Bancos de Dados


SQL sólido, principalmente em MySQL e/ou PostgreSQL.

Capacidade de modelagem, otimização e entendimento de desempenho.

Arquitetura & Escalabilidade


Experiência com microsserviços, mensageria, event-driven e integrações complexas.

Entendimento sobre escalabilidade horizontal/vertical, HA, tolerância a falhas e boas práticas de arquitetura.

Containers


Uso de Docker no dia a dia para criação de ambientes consistentes.

Mensageria e Eventos


Familiaridade com SQS, Kafka ou similares.

Entendimento de sync vs async, consistência e padrões de comunicação.

Segurança


Conhecimento de OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT e boas práticas de segurança em APIs.


Desejável:

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplos produtos e frentes de trabalho simultâneas, onde o contexto pode mudar rapidamente e é necessário gerenciar prioridades de forma estratégica e adaptável.

Experiência no setor de saúde ou em ambientes regulados (healthtechs, pharma, planos de saúde, fintechs, etc.).

Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, prescrições digitais, prontuário eletrônico ou jornada de pacientes e médicos.

Vivência com produtos de mídia digital, marketplaces ou plataformas B2B2C.

Experiência com monetização de produtos digitais, modelos de negócio baseados em dados ou publicidade.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Functional Consultant
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption. The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

• Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.

• Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.

• Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.

• Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return) Functional Process Data Ownership


Responsibilities include:

• Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

• Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

• Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

• Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

• Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

• Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

• Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

• Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

• Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

• Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

• Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

• Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

• Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

• Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

• Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications:

Experience

• 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

• Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

• Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

• Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.


Technical & Functional Skills:

• Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

• Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

• Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

• Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

• Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills:

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

• Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

• Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

• Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant (AWS – HIPAA)
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking. You’re motivated by building robust AWS architectures that meet strict security and compliance requirements—especially in healthcare-related contexts—and by collaborating closely with engineering, security, and compliance teams to deliver reliable cloud platforms.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong professional experience as a Cloud Architect on AWS , owning end-to-end architectural decisions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services , including Lightsail .
  • Experience working with cPanel-based environments hosted on AWS.
  • Solid knowledge of HIPAA compliance and proven experience designing and maintaining HIPAA-compliant cloud architectures on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, network security, and data protection.
  • Experience implementing and reviewing security controls aligned with regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, security, and compliance teams.
  • Strong documentation skills for architecture designs, decisions, and compliance considerations.
  • Comfortable providing technical guidance and architectural leadership across teams.
  • Excellent English communication skills for working with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and compliant AWS cloud architectures.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve HIPAA-compliant architectures, following AWS best practices and approved services.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and technical standards.
  • Define and enforce security controls, including encryption, access management, and network protections.
  • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to development and infrastructure teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of cloud standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

You’re motivated by building robust AWS architectures that meet strict security and compliance requirements—especially in healthcare-related contexts—and by collaborating closely with engineering, security, and compliance teams to deliver reliable cloud platforms.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong professional experience as a Cloud Architect on AWS , owning end-to-end architectural decisions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services , including Lightsail .
  • Experience working with cPanel-based environments hosted on AWS.
  • Solid knowledge of HIPAA compliance and proven experience designing and maintaining HIPAA-compliant cloud architectures on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, network security, and data protection.
  • Experience implementing and reviewing security controls aligned with regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, security, and compliance teams.
  • Strong documentation skills for architecture designs, decisions, and compliance considerations.
  • Comfortable providing technical guidance and architectural leadership across teams.
  • Excellent English communication skills for working with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and compliant AWS cloud architectures.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve HIPAA-compliant architectures, following AWS best practices and approved services.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and technical standards.
  • Define and enforce security controls, including encryption, access management, and network protections.
  • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to development and infrastructure teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of cloud standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: SAP Source to Pay Consultant
description:
Brunel is looking to hire SAP Source to Pay (STP) Functional Consultants – S/4HANA to work remotely with our client, located in Calgary, Canada.


Our client, a major player in the Oil & Gas sector, is currently integrating a newly onboarded company into an existing SAP S/4HANA landscape . We are looking for hands-on SAP STP Functional Consultants with strong implementation and integration experience to support this critical transformation project. This role requires build and delivery experience . Profiles focused mainly on AMS or production support will not be considered. Mid-level and Senior professionals are encoraged to apply.


Work Schedule: Remote (Calgary time)

Contract: Full-time | 40 hours/week

End Date: January 2027 (1 year duration


Responsibilities:

  • Deliver end-to-end Source to Pay (STP) solutions in SAP S/4HANA
  • Design and execute cross-module and boundary-system integrations
  • Independently write functional specifications
  • Perform process design, configuration, and implementation in SAP S/4HANA (version 2302)
  • Collaborate with PP, Logistics, and integration teams across the SAP landscape
  • Support integration of business processes during company onboarding


Requirements:

  • Fluent English - no flexibility no this requirement
  • Strong SAP Source to Pay (STP) functional experience
  • Hands-on SAP S/4HANA configuration (implementation-focused)
  • Proven experience writing functional specifications
  • Solid integration background , including: PP / Logistics Execution, MM / PI integrations, Boundary systems and cross-functional integrations
  • Oil & Gas project experience (mandatory)


Ideal Profile:

  • Implementation-focused SAP consultant (not AMS/support-heavy)
  • Comfortable working independently in complex integration environments
  • Strong communication and documentation skills
  • Experience working on large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Processos (SAP PM/MM)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Domínio do módulo PM do SAP.

Conhecimento em MM (Material Management) e integração com dados mestres.

Experiência com estruturação de planos de manutenção, ordens, notificações e ciclos de vida de ativos.

Capacidade de parametrização e análise de dados no SAP.

Conhecimento em ServiceNow e integração com processos ITIL (desejável).

Excel avançado e Power BI para análise e visualização de dados.

Habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe

Vivência em ambientes industriais, telecomunicações ou de infraestrutura tecnológica.

Participação em projetos de implantação ou melhoria de SAP PM/MM.

Atuação em processos de transição de ativos de projetos para operação.

Conhecimento em engenharia de manutenção aplicada à entrada de novos ativos.

Vivência com processos de controle inicial conforme Elemento 8 do VPS.

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Assistência Médica;

title: Intern
description:
Vaga de Estágio – Marketing & Operacional



Local:  São Paulo – modelo híbrido

(3x presencial | 2x home office)



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar de forma integrada entre marketing e operações, apoiando o dia a dia da Balmo.

Essa é uma vaga mão na massa, ideal para quem quer entender como uma marca de cosméticos funciona por completo — do conteúdo nas redes sociais até o pedido chegando na casa do cliente.

Você vai apoiar processos, criar, organizar, se relacionar com a comunidade e aprender fazendo, com autonomia.


Principais responsabilidades


Marketing & Comunidade


  • Apoiar a gestão da comunidade nas redes sociais (Instagram e TikTok);
  • Gerir ações de marketing de influência;
  • Responder mensagens, comentários e interações com linguagem alinhada à marca;
  • Apoiar a criação de conteúdos (stories, vídeos, bastidores e trends);
  • Participar de ativações, eventos e ações presenciais da marca;
  • Pesquisar referências, tendências e novas ideias de conteúdo;
  • Apoiar estratégias de engajamento e fortalecimento da marca;


Operações


  • Apoiar os processos operacionais do e-commerce (organização de pedidos, controle de estoque, expedição e envios);
  • Dar suporte ao atendimento ao cliente (pedidos, prazos, trocas e dúvidas).


Requisitos


  • Estar cursando Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, proatividade e criatividade;
  • Familiaridade com Instagram, TikTok e ferramentas digitais (conforto em aparecer em vídeos e conteúdos nas redes sociais);
  • Noções básicas de Excel / Google Sheets;
  • Interesse por marcas, marketing, startups e e-commerce.


Diferenciais


  • Interesse por marketing de influência e construção de comunidade;
  • Vontade de crescer junto com uma marca em fase de expansão;
  • Sensibilidade estética e cuidado com linguagem de marca;
  • Curiosidade por processos operacionais e bastidores de e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico em Shopify, Bling ou ferramentas similares;



Modelo de contrato


  • Contrato de estágio;
  • Salário fixo + vale transporte;

Requisitos


  • Estar cursando Administração, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, proatividade e criatividade;
  • Familiaridade com Instagram, TikTok e ferramentas digitais (conforto em aparecer em vídeos e conteúdos nas redes sociais);
  • Noções básicas de Excel / Google Sheets;
  • Interesse por marcas, marketing, startups e e-commerce.


Diferenciais


  • Interesse por marketing de influência e construção de comunidade;
  • Vontade de crescer junto com uma marca em fase de expansão;
  • Sensibilidade estética e cuidado com linguagem de marca;
  • Curiosidade por processos operacionais e bastidores de e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico em Shopify, Bling ou ferramentas similares;



Modelo de contrato


  • Contrato de estágio;
  • Salário fixo + vale transporte;

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Python/AWS Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57017



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Fullstack com boa experiência em Java, Python, AWS (AWS CloudFormation, AWS Lambda), JavaScript.
  • CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

title: Junior OCC Developer – OSF (Remote)
description:
Olá!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono , oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados.

INCREASE THE POWER OF YOUR BUSINESS.


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em OCC;
  • Apoio na configuração, ajuste e manutenção de workflows em OSF / OSM;
  • Análise e correção de incidentes de baixa e média complexidade;
  • Suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Integração entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de Web Services REST e SOAP;
  • Execução de testes técnicos e validações funcionais;
  • Apoio na documentação técnica;
  • Trabalho colaborativo com desenvolvedores pleno e sênior.


❇️ O que esperamos de você – Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com OCC (Oracle Commerce Cloud);
  • Conhecimento técnico ou funcional em OSF (Oracle Storefront Framework) / OSM Framework;
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Vivência com suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência ou vivência em projetos de telecomunicações;
  • Facilidade de aprendizado e adaptação a novos frameworks.


❇️ O que esperamos de você – Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Trabalho em equipe.


✨ O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$39,71/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeados pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (ReactJS / Svelte)
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (ReactJS / Svelte)

Location: Remote

Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Frontend Engineer with expertise in ReactJS and/or Svelte to join our team. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and Backend teams to deliver a world-class user experience to millions of users across web and OTT platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Backend teams to design and deliver engaging, high-quality user experiences.
  • Design and implement features with robustness, anticipating failures and edge cases.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of features, workflows, and processes.
  • Communicate progress effectively through Jira, Slack, and Confluence.
  • Develop applications for a variety of OTT devices including Set Top Boxes, Connected TVs (LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Vizio SmartCast, Hisense Vidaa), and gaming consoles (PS4, PS5, Xbox One).
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work, including code quality and feature delivery.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced agile development environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience developing web applications using ReactJS and/or Svelte.
  • Strong experience integrating REST APIs and rapidly learning new APIs/SDKs.
  • At least 1 year of Typescript development experience.
  • Experience working with build tools like Nx, Rspack, Vite, Webpack.
  • Proven experience in developing and supporting high-traffic consumer or business applications.

Preferred / “Nice-to-Have” Skills:

  • Experience building high-performance applications for low-resource devices.
  • Experience in streaming video application development.

title: Analista de SOC (Projeto México / 24x7)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

• Ampla experiência com ferramentas SIEM (por exemplo, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, AlienVault, ArcSight) para monitoramento, detecção e resposta a incidentes de segurança.

• Familiaridade com metodologias de resposta a incidentes, incluindo detecção, análise, contenção, erradicação e recuperação.

• Capacidade de reconhecer e responder a ameaças de segurança comuns, incluindo phishing, malware, ataques DDoS, ameaças internas e ataques.

• Proficiência em soluções de detecção e resposta de endpoints (EDR).

• Disponibilidade para trabalhar 24x7 em 3 turnos (7h-18h / 18h-02:00 / 02:00-10h)

• Proficiência avançada em Espanhol é obrigatória.


Responsabilidades:

Monitorar continuamente o tráfego de rede, os registros de segurança e os alertas de diversas ferramentas de segurança (por exemplo, SIEM, firewalls, sistemas de detecção e prevenção de intrusões). Analisar eventos e alertas de segurança para identificar padrões, anomalias e ameaças potenciais. Utilizar painéis de segurança e ferramentas de geração de relatórios para detectar atividades suspeitas, anomalias de rede ou comportamentos maliciosos. Investigar e analisar potenciais incidentes de segurança utilizando plataformas de gerenciamento de informações e eventos de segurança (SIEM), como Microsoft Sentinel (preferencialmente), Splunk, QRadar ou ArcSight. Seguir os procedimentos estabelecidos de resposta a incidentes para conter e mitigar ameaças à segurança, escalando incidentes para a equipe sênior do SOC, conforme necessário.


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote CLT de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Estamos em busca de um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeos & Designer com forte experiência prática em criativos de performance , especialmente para Reels de Instagram, TikTok e anúncios de captação de leads e conversão .

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:

SUA MISSÃO:

A pessoa coordenadora atua como uma ponte entre a estratégia macro e a execução, garantindo que os times de Product Owners/Managers, Frontend e Backend tenham os recursos, a orientação e o ambiente necessários para entregar valor constante ao negócio.

Seu principal foco será o desenvolvimento de talentos, excelência operacional e entrega tática.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

• Gestão de Pessoas: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe, realizando 1:1s, planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e avaliações de desempenho.

• Alinhamento Tático: Garantir que as squads sob sua coordenação estejam alinhadas com os

OKRs da área e que as dependências entre times sejam gerenciadas com eficiência.

• Refinamento de Processos: Implementar e otimizar metodologias de discovery e delivery, garantindo agilidade e qualidade sem burocracia excessiva.

• Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de apoio para áreas parceiras (Vendas, CX,

Engenharia), traduzindo prioridades e gerenciando expectativas de curto e médio prazo.

• Suporte ao Discovery: Apoiar o time na validação de hipóteses e na construção de roadmaps realistas e baseados em dados.


O QUE ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ SAIBA:

• Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor; domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); conhecimento em métricas de produto (NPS, Churn, LTV, conversão); experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Notion, etc.).

• Liderança servidora, habilidade em resolução de conflitos, comunicação clara e assertiva, capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks construtivos e organização multitarefa.

• Conhecimento básico em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação para backend nas linguagens Ruby on Rails, Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP.

• Noções de bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL

Server).

Conhecimento básico sobre o funcionamento de APis REST.

• Domínio de um framework (React, Vue, Angular) e seu ecossistema.

• Profundo conhecimento em gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Vuex, Zustand, etc.).

• Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack, Vite) e pré-processadores

(SASS).

• Habilidade em criar e manter testes automatizados (Jest, Cypress).

• ¡OS Nativo (Swift):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, VIPER).

• Profundo conhecimento em SwiftUl e/ou UIKit para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods) e concorrência (GCD, Swift Concurrency).

• Android Nativo (Kotlin):

• Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (MVVM, MVI) e dos componentes Jetpack.

• Profundo conhecimento em Jetpack Compose e/ou XML para layouts complexos.

• Experiência com Coroutines/Flow para programação assíncrona e Dagger/Hilt para injeção de dependência.

• Flutter (Dart):

• Domínio de padrões de gerenciamento de estado avançados (BLoC, Riverpod).

• Habilidade em criar widgets customizados e complexos.

• Experiência com canais de plataforma (platform channels) para integração com código nativo.

• Mentalidade Orientada a Dados: Capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em evidências.

• Empatia pelo Cliente: Um desejo profundo de entender e resolver os problemas dos usuários.

• Espírito Colaborativo: Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe com desenvolvedores, designers, marketing e outras áreas.

• Resiliência e Adaptação: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes de incerteza e mudar de curso

quando necessário.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).
  • Contractor will issue monthly invoices for services rendered.
  • No employment relationship (CLT), and no employment benefits (transportation, vacation, 13th salary, etc.) are provided.
  • Flexible hours and autonomy in executing tasks, while meeting project deadlines and deliverables.

Keywords: Javascript, React, Node.js, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, Front-end, Back-end, Mobile (iOS/Android), React Native, Web Development, Software Development, R&D, Prototyping, QA, Algorithms, Engineering, Technology.

title: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead
description:
Job Description: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead

Duration: 7 months

100% Remote opportunity within USA and Brazil


Position Purpose :

  • Currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.
  • Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.
  • The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S/4HANA.
  • Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return) Functional Process


Data Ownership Responsibilities include:

  • Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.


Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.


Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.


Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.
  • Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.
  • Technical & Functional Skills
  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.
  • Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).
  • Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.
  • Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!


Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado:


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding

title: SAP RTR (Record to Report) Functional Consultant
description:
Brunel is looking to hire a SAP RTR (Record to Report) Functional Consultant – S/4HANA to work remotely with our client, located in Calgary, Canada.


Our client, a major player in the Oil & Gas sector, is currently integrating a newly onboarded company into an existing SAP S/4HANA landscape . We are looking for hands-on SAP RTR Functional Consultants with strong implementation and integration experience to support this critical transformation project. This role requires build and delivery experience . Mid-level professionals are encoraged to apply.


Profiles focused mainly on AMS or support activities will not be considered.


Work Schedule: Remote (Calgary time)

Contract: Full-time | 40 hours/week

End Date: January 2027 (1 year duration)


Responsibilities:

  • Configure and support Record to Report (RTR) processes in SAP S/4HANA
  • Lead and support General Ledger (GL) configuration, including: Chart of Accounts, Document Splitting, Parallel Ledgers, Financial Closing activities
  • Support end-to-end financial close processes
  • Design and manage integration between GL and sub-ledgers (AP, AR, and Asset Accounting)
  • Configure and support: Automatic Account Determination, Foreign Currency Valuation, Intercompany Postings, Financial Statement Versions (FSV)
  • Conduct client workshops , prepare functional documentation, and present solution designs
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams during system integration and go-live activities


Requirements :

  • Fluent English - no flexibility no this requirement
  • Proven SAP RTR functional experience
  • Hands-on GL configuration in SAP S/4HANA
  • Strong understanding of AP, AR, and Asset Accounting (AA) integrations
  • Solid experience with financial close processes
  • Oil & Gas project experience (mandatory)
  • Strong communication, client-facing, and presentation skills


Ideal Profile:

  • Implementation-driven SAP consultant with S/4HANA experience
  • Comfortable working independently in complex finance transformation projects
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • Experience working on large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs within Oil & Gas environments

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Global Process Data Consultant | SAP S/4HANA | OTC & MTO | Data Migration & Governance
description:
Position Purpose

undertaking multiple large-scale global transformation initiatives , including a greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC, MTO).

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant/Lead to support data conversion, migration, governance, and ongoing data management . This role is critical in ensuring business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and user adoption.

The consultant will act as a bridge between business process owners, SAP functional teams, and the data enablement organization , embedding data requirements into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned with standardized value stream processes
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for SAP S/4HANA
  • Support global template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return)

2. Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards

3. Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation cycles
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover

4. Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies
  • Collaborate closely with Master Data Management and Data Governance teams
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes

5. Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy and completeness
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and newly created data
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization during hypercare

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with a strong focus on data
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred)
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations
  • Strong understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects, including:
  • Material Master
  • Customer / Business Partner
  • Vendor
  • BOMs
  • Routings
  • Pricing
  • Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC
  • Experience with SAP MDG or similar data governance tools (preferred)
  • Familiarity with data migration tools such as SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, or ETL tools
  • Ability to interpret functional specifications and data models

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries
  • Prior experience as a Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics

title: Global Process Data Consultant | SAP S/4HANA | OTC & MTO | Data Migration & Governance

undertaking multiple large-scale global transformation initiatives , including a greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC, MTO).

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant/Lead to support data conversion, migration, governance, and ongoing data management . This role is critical in ensuring business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and user adoption.

The consultant will act as a bridge between business process owners, SAP functional teams, and the data enablement organization , embedding data requirements into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned with standardized value stream processes
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for SAP S/4HANA
  • Support global template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return)

2. Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards

3. Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation cycles
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover

4. Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies
  • Collaborate closely with Master Data Management and Data Governance teams
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes

5. Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy and completeness
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and newly created data
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization during hypercare

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with a strong focus on data
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred)
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.
