• Gerenciar, expandir e fortalecer a carteira de clientes da Blockbit no setor público, com foco nas regiões de MT, MS, RO e AC;

• Desenvolver e executar estratégias de vendas para soluções de cibersegurança, alinhadas aos objetivos de crescimento da Blockbit;

• Atuar de forma proativa na prospecção de novas oportunidades, conduzindo todo o ciclo de vendas – da identificação à negociação e fechamento do contrato;

• Construir e manter um pipeline de vendas qualificado, avaliando oportunidades e provisionando receita com precisão;

• Representar a Blockbit em eventos, encontros institucionais e fóruns relevantes para o setor público, reforçando o posicionamento da Blockbit como referência em cibersegurança nacional;

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, propondo soluções aderentes às necessidades dos clientes, com apoio das áreas técnica e de pré-vendas;

• Acompanhar tendências e demandas do mercado público, garantindo o posicionamento competitivo da Blockbit.


Requisitos:

• Experiência mínima de 2 anos em vendas no setor de tecnologia – preferencialmente cibersegurança - para o setor público e privado nas regiões MT, MS, RO e AC;

• Histórico consistente de atingimento de metas e estabilidade profissional;

• Conhecimento profundo da estrutura de compras públicas, leis de licitação, portais de compras e processos decisórios nos governos estaduais e municipais das regiões Norte e Nordeste;

• Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com capacidade de estabelecer relações positivas com autoridades, representantes públicos e parceiros;

• Perfil consultivo, com autonomia, resiliência, organização e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e orientada a resultados;

• Será considerado diferencial: Conhecimento em produtos e soluções de cibersegurança tais como Firewall, SD-WAN, SIEM e XDR


O que oferecemos:

• Contratação CLT, com pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, comissões agressivas e benefícios atrativos;

• Oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa líder no mercado de cibersegurança.

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com foco em inovação.

• Desenvolvimento profissional contínuo em um dos setores mais estratégicos e em franca expansão.

Se você tem paixão por tecnologia e deseja atuar no centro da transformação digital do nosso país, envie seu currículo para a Blockbit e venha fazer parte do time que está protegendo o futuro digital do Brasil.

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.


Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent-level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.


Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces ), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end-to-end automated research solution.


The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high-impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full-stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast-paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high-volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server-side logic, integrating with third-party services using C# and object-oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building back-end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Flutter and/or native mobile development (iOS/Android), including the MVVM design pattern


Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development technologies, specifically Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Comfort with fast-moving teams and working across time zones with distributed teams.


PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high-standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.





PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: Azure / Windows Architect
description:
Job Title: Azure/Windows Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.
  • Design landing zones: Understand customer infra landscape; design and build Azure Landing Zones aligned to business, application, and infrastructure strategies.
  • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.
  • Define end‑to‑end solutions: Realize solution architecture addressing business processes, regulatory needs, quality attributes, and cost efficiency.
  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.


Apply today or share profiles at

description:

Esse cargo exige alta capacidade de comunicação, domínio de técnicas de venda, inteligência emocional e foco em resultados.

O objetivo central é transformar oportunidades em contratos fechados, mantendo uma taxa de conversão saudável e garantindo a satisfação do cliente.

  • Fechar contratos de R$10k a R$60k

  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos

  • Comunicação consultiva

  • Comercial

title: Technical Manager
description:
We are looking for highly motivated Technical Manager with strong experience in high-voltage (HV) transmission equipment in Brazil.Our client is a global leading manufacturer specialized in power transformers and power transmission and distribution equipment.


This is a unique opportunity to work with a global leader, supporting grid operators and participating in international tenders. Technical Manager will act as the key point of contact for key clients, qualifying HV equipment and managing projects.


The company offers a local contract, full remote work and a competitive benefits package based on experience.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with grid operators (TSOs/DSOs), utilities, and strategic key accounts.
  • Lead and support tender preparation, technical qualifications, and bid evaluations for high-voltage transmission equipment.
  • Oversee and follow up on awarded projects, ensuring successful technical execution, contractual compliance, and commercial performance.
  • Act as the primary technical interface between customers, EPCs, internal engineering teams, and suppliers throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Serve as the technical authority and subject-matter expert for high-voltage equipment, including power transformers, GIS, switchgear, capacitors, and HVDC converters.


Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or a similar technical field (MBA is a plus)
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy or electrical infrastructure sector, with strong exposure to HV systems
  • Proven experience in transmission, utility, EPC, or grid operator environments
  • Experience participating in local and international tenders
  • Languages: English required
  • Ability to work independently in a flexible, remote work environment

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Position : Front End (React) Developer

Years of exp: 4 + Years in React

Location : Remote ( Brazil )

Duration : 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)

work time : Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST


Role Overview


You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Evaluation Process


  • Technical Interview with live coding challenge focused on React(60 mins)

description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Sr. Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.

  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation and Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 5+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

title: Pessoa Consultora Dynamics Business Central
description:
Atuação LATAM | Espanhol Avançado | Remoto


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Consultora Funcional Business Central (Microsoft Dynamics 365) para atuar em projetos estratégicos com o time LATAM , incluindo interação direta com equipes da Argentina. Se você tem perfil analítico, gosta de entender processos de negócio e transformar necessidades em soluções eficientes, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e os processos de negócio dos clientes, propondo soluções eficazes com o Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC) ;
  • Configurar, implantar e customizar o Business Central conforme os requisitos específicos de cada cliente;
  • Atuar nos módulos de Finance/Accounting, Trade e Warehouse, incluindo processos de importação e exportação;
  • Fornecer treinamento e suporte contínuo aos usuários finais, garantindo a correta adoção do sistema;
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação técnica e funcional detalhada;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e externas para integração do Business Central com outros sistemas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas funcionalidades, tendências e atualizações do Business Central e tecnologias relacionadas.


✅ Requisitos

  • Espanhol avançado para atuação com times LATAM;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ;
  • Experiência com processos de Trade, Finance-Accounting e Warehouse;
  • Conhecimentos em processos fiscais brasileiros;
  • Formação técnica ou vivência profissional em contabilidade, engenharia industrial ou áreas afins;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e visão de processos de negócio.

title: QA Analyst (Remote) - Brazil
description:
Description


Magentrix leads the Partner Relationship Management market with a platform that benefits companies that sell through indirect channels (i.e. resellers, referrals, affiliates, distributors) with innovative solutions and a customer-centric approach. Recently ranked as a top contender by Forrester Research, we're on a mission to redefine partnerships in the tech industry.


SUMMARY


Magentrix corporation is seeking for a permanent Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to join their team. In this role, you are responsible to assure the quality of the product is met before deployment to production servers. You will need to have a solid understanding of all QA procedures and apply them effectively on each release.

NOTE: this role is remote, full-time.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Working closely with the development team to deliver quality software to our clients.
  • Develop test plans, test cases, test scripts and test reports based on the requirements.
  • Review user requirement documents to ensure the new features are testable.
  • Fully test the application with all edge cases before release.
  • Validate that user expectations are achieved during the testing process.
  • Determine LOE for individual issues in the backlog before starting the test.
  • Prepare clear, precise and multi-step test cases for each issue in the backlog.
  • Write Playwright test scripts and create automated test cases.
  •  Run test end to end testing, smoke testing and time to time regression testing.


QUALIFICATIONS


  • Minimum 5 years of experience in testing complex enterprise web-based applications.
  • Excellent knowledge of software testing, concepts and procedures.
  • High Playwright Knowledge and automated testing are needed.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Degree in Business Administration, Software Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of QA process for software development, debugging and release.
  • Solid knowledge of sanity, smoke and regression testing procedures.
  • Familiar with Agile software development methodology.
  • Assess, evaluate and time estimate defects, enhancements and large scale tasks.
  • Ability to write multi-step and precise test cases for defects and issues.
  • Familiar with automated testing tools.
  • Knowledge of CRM software such as Salesforce or MS Dynamics is a plus.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como Tech Lead React Web, sendo a referência técnica do time e também alguém que trabalha de forma ativa no desenvolvimento. Seu papel envolve orientar a equipe, garantir a qualidade das entregas, apoiar decisões técnicas, participar de entrevistas, promover as melhores práticas de frontend e assegurar que processos, documentação e ritmo de evolução do time estejam sempre alinhados. Além de liderar, você colocará a mão na massa na construção de interfaces, criação de componentes escaláveis e manutenção de uma base sólida de frontend, contribuindo diretamente para a experiência do usuário e para a evolução contínua do projeto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar e acompanhar objetivos do time, garantindo que os processos da Rethink sejam seguidos;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das tarefas ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, identificando riscos para a entrega e atuando para mitigá-los;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis com React, desenvolvendo interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, e colaborando com design e backend;
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho para manter interfaces rápidas e confiáveis;
  • Realizar revisões de código, orientar padrões e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) em tecnologias e boas práticas de frontend;
  • Atuar como a principal referência técnica para o time e para o cliente, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do projeto e capacidades da equipe;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e avaliar candidatos para compor o time de TI sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que o perfil técnico e comportamental esteja aderente às necessidades do projeto;
  • Garantir que o time mantenha atualizadas as ferramentas e artefatos essenciais ao fluxo de trabalho, como Jira, documentações e registros de processo, preservando organização, histórico e visibilidade;
  • Identificar oportunidades de capacitação e necessidades de desenvolvimento do time, promovendo nivelamento técnico e incentivando uma evolução contínua e estruturada da equipe;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na elaboração de cronogramas e estimativas, trazendo visão técnica para planejar entregas, dimensionar esforço e antecipar riscos;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, aplicando boas práticas de UX/UI e garantindo uma experiência fluida, inclusiva e eficiente para o usuário;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento web, guiando decisões técnicas, garantindo a adoção de boas práticas e assegurando que o produto avance com qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Domínio no desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores de CSS (ex: SASS, LESS);
  • Familiaridade com testes de frontend (ex: Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de User Experience (UX) e User Interface (UI);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, preferencialmente Git;
  • Conhecimento em prototipagem de interfaces utilizando Figma ou outras ferramentas de design;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful, com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD aplicadas ao frontend;
  • Proatividade, perfil comunicativo, resolução de problemas complexos e busca por melhoria contínua.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com TypeScript;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciamento de dependências usando NPM e/ou YARN;
  • Conhecer bibliotecas de UI como Material UI, Ant Design ou similares;
  • Aplicar práticas de acessibilidade seguindo diretrizes como WCAG;
  • Tiver vivência com integrações em nuvem (AWS ou outras plataformas);
  • Conhecer princípios de SEO aplicados a aplicações web;
  • Tiver experiência com arquitetura de projetos complexos.



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

title: SAP S/4HANA Security & Authorisation Manager
description:
SAP S/4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core

Locations: Slough, UK - Sao Paolo, Brazil - Warsaw, Poland


As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas: Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S/4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S/4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.
  • Collaborate effectively within a diverse team that fosters an inclusive culture, ensuring all contributions are valued and recognised.
  • Stay informed on emerging security threats and apply industry best practices to strengthen SAP application security and controls.


Context and Scope

Programs are often marked by a seamless transition from the old system/landscape to the new one. As part of this SAP S/4HANA Digital Transformation program, we require someone with high-level expertise and experience in SAP Security & Authorisations in S/4HANA including FIORI.

The successful candidate will support the delivery of the security scope and collaborate with counterparts at Mars (i.e. Petcare, Corporate, Snacking and Food) to capture and analyse authorisation requirements and security related activities.



Education and Professional

  • 10+ years in SAP Security and Authorisations with at least three full life cycle implementations in S/4HANA and FIORI.
  • Professional certification such as SAP Certified Technology Professional, SAP Access Control 12.0, or other relevant security certifications.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA security and authorisations including role design administration and integration with FIORI.
  • Proficiency in security design, configuration, testing and deployment across key technologies including SAP S/4HANA, Fiori and SAP Master Data Governance (MDG).
  • Strong understanding of authorisation concepts for S/4 HANA including FIORI, Business Technology Platform (BTP) and other Cloud applications such SuccessFactors, Ariba, & SAP MDG.
  • Deep knowledge of SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), GDPR, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent understanding of S/4HANA product roadmap.
  • Highly organised with proven experience in setting and managing deadlines across diverse stakeholder groups while ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong team player mindset with a drive to develop new professional skills combined with proactive, growth oriented and goal-focused approach to work.
  • Excellent documentation, visualisation and presentation skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft office tools particularly PowerPoint and Excel with expertise in building complex formulas, developing pivot tables and creating data-driven reports and presentations.
  • Experience working with System and Business Integrators.
  • Ability to work under pressure and maintain a professional manner.


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: GESTOR DE MARKETING E DADOS
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Gerenciar a performance operacional de todos os parceiros terceirizados de backend (SalesBound, Logicall, HelpGrid, etc).
  • Garantir que os dados estejam sendo recebidos e enviados corretamente, com integridade e consistência.
  • Estabelecer e manter rotinas de calls semanais com os parceiros, com foco em performance. (Todas calls são em inglês)
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos processos de backend com base em KPIs, dados e feedback das áreas envolvidas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico para auditar e corrigir integrações e fluxos de dados.
  • Estruturar e monitorar os principais KPIs de backend, com foco em lucro por lead.
  • Colaborar com os times de SMS, E-mail, Amazon e novos canais, dando suporte ao acompanhamento de métricas e análises.
  • Contribuir na estruturação e formalização dos processos internos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Acompanhar e garantir a evolução de projetos como dashboards, investigações de chargeback, estruturação de novos canais e auditorias.


QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Inglês fluente para conduzir reuniões com fornecedores externos;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e pessoas ;
  • Capacidade de liderança e organização de times operacionais ;
  • Experiência com criação e estruturação de processos internos.
  • Experiência prévia com backend em marketing digital ou áreas operacionais similares;
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de integração, webhooks e auditoria de dados;
  • Capacidade de relacionamento com fornecedores e times técnicos;
  • Entendimento sólido de KPIs operacionais (como ROI, lucro por lead, taxa de conversão);
  • Experiência com acompanhamento de performance de parceiros externos;
  • Experiência com CRM, Looker Studio, planilhas e ferramentas de gestão de dados;


COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • COMUNICAÇÃO ASSERTIVA
  • LIDERANÇA OPERACIONAL
  • ANÁLISE DE DADOS
  • COBRANÇA E RIGOR DE EXECUÇÃO
  • PROATIVIDADE E RESOLUÇÃO DE PROBLEMAS
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO E DOCUMENTAÇÃO

SALÁRIO:

  • Ser negociado 


TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.


COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

  • Garantir que os dados estejam sendo recebidos e enviados corretamente, com integridade e consistência.
  • Estabelecer e manter rotinas de calls semanais com os parceiros, com foco em performance. (Todas calls são em inglês)
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos processos de backend com base em KPIs, dados e feedback das áreas envolvidas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico para auditar e corrigir integrações e fluxos de dados.
  • Estruturar e monitorar os principais KPIs de backend, com foco em lucro por lead.
  • Colaborar com os times de SMS, E-mail, Amazon e novos canais, dando suporte ao acompanhamento de métricas e análises.
  • Contribuir na estruturação e formalização dos processos internos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Acompanhar e garantir a evolução de projetos como dashboards, investigações de chargeback, estruturação de novos canais e auditorias.


QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Inglês fluente para conduzir reuniões com fornecedores externos;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e pessoas ;
  • Capacidade de liderança e organização de times operacionais ;
  • Experiência com criação e estruturação de processos internos.
  • Experiência prévia com backend em marketing digital ou áreas operacionais similares;
  • Conhecimento de rotinas de integração, webhooks e auditoria de dados;
  • Capacidade de relacionamento com fornecedores e times técnicos;
  • Entendimento sólido de KPIs operacionais (como ROI, lucro por lead, taxa de conversão);
  • Experiência com acompanhamento de performance de parceiros externos;
  • Experiência com CRM, Looker Studio, planilhas e ferramentas de gestão de dados;


COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • COMUNICAÇÃO ASSERTIVA
  • LIDERANÇA OPERACIONAL
  • ANÁLISE DE DADOS
  • COBRANÇA E RIGOR DE EXECUÇÃO
  • PROATIVIDADE E RESOLUÇÃO DE PROBLEMAS
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO E DOCUMENTAÇÃO

SALÁRIO:

  • Ser negociado 


TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.


COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

  • Elaborar o roadmap evolutivo do atendimento digital, considerando a estratégia de negócio e o contexto tecnológico, incluindo a evolução de soluções digitais e iniciativas com agentes de IA.;

  • Manter a visão de futuro do atendimento digital, identificando e avaliando gaps da arquitetura atual e propondo melhorias.
  • Buscar e propor oportunidades de evolução do atendimento digital ou adoção de novas práticas tecnológicas, por meio de estudos e prospecção de mercado em Telecom e Digital.
  • Coordenar ou executar a evolução da arquitetura existente utilizando melhores práticas, ferramentas emergentes e alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas.
  • Prospectar e avaliar evoluções aplicacionais em trabalho conjunto com grupos multidisciplinares.
  • Relacionar-se com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos, garantindo alinhamento técnico entre arquitetura, digital e negócio.
  • Participar de PoCs para validar implementações, incluindo componentes aplicacionais e funcionalidades emergentes relacionadas à automação e IA no atendimento digital.


Experiência, conhecimentos e formação:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software, Engenharia de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou Transformação Digital.
  • Experiência sólida na elaboração e manutenção de arquiteturas de referência corporativas, com foco aplicacional e funcional.
  • Vivência em definição de padrões arquiteturais, governança técnica e alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Experiência em apoiar múltiplas equipes na definição de soluções, avaliando requisitos, gaps e riscos tecnológicos.
  • Histórico na evolução de arquiteturas corporativas, propondo melhorias com base em práticas de mercado e tendências tecnológicas.
  • Atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Participação em PoCs e validação de soluções em cenários complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, preferencialmente com exposição a iniciativas digitais e aplicações de média/alta complexidade

title: Virtual Assistant - Real Estate Operations & Marketing
description:
Polaris Advisors is a high-performing real estate team at Compass , specializing in residential sales, investments, and advisory services in South Florida. Known for its strategic approach, strong operational structure, and client-focused execution, Polaris Advisors delivers a high-level experience across every stage of the real estate process.


We are seeking a high-performing Virtual Assistant based in Brazil to support our Real Estate Operations and Marketing team at a high-producing team at Compass . This is a remote position for candidates located in Brazil , compensated in Brazilian Reais (BRL) .


This role requires a professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy , and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven U.S. real estate environment .


You will work closely with the Real Estate Operations Manager and the Principal of the team , supporting property listings, marketing initiatives, and operational workflows. This position is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and consistently delivers high-quality execution.


Training will be provided on MLS systems and the Compass platform , and the ideal candidate must demonstrate a strong ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.


Key Responsibilities


Administrative Operations

• Prepare and manage buyer and seller documentation using the Compass platform

• Organize and maintain internal trackers, digital files, and compliance documentation using Google Drive and Compass systems

• Maintain the listing and transaction pipeline with accurate and up-to-date information

• Coordinate post-closing follow-ups, including testimonial requests


Listing & Deal Coordination

• Coordinate listing preparation, including ordering photography, signage, and related services

• Upload and manage listings across Compass, MLS, Zillow, and related platforms

• Prepare marketing materials, including social media posts, open house flyers, and email blasts

• Ensure full compliance with Compass systems and listing requirements

• Monitor and update status changes across all platforms in real time


Marketing & Lead Management

• Design and distribute e-blasts, brochures, newsletters, and social media posts using the Compass Marketing Center

• Manage the team’s Instagram and Facebook pages, supporting content creation, scheduling, and posting

• Coordinate print campaigns and seasonal marketing drops, including mail execution via Postalytics

• Support lead management and follow-ups as needed


Events & Client Support

• Present and organize vendor quotes (venues, invitations, catering, promotional items)

• Support team events and client-facing initiatives as needed

Qualifications

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in a support role such as Executive Assistant, Operations, or Marketing

• Real estate experience strongly preferred, particularly in U.S. real estate operations

• Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using: Google Workspace, E-signature tools, CRM systems, Canva, and AI (ChatGPT)

• Strong written communication skills, with excellent grammar and clarity

• Highly detail-oriented and process-driven, with the ability to manage follow-ups, deadlines, and shifting priorities independently

• Ability to organize tasks, track progress, and proactively flag issues

• Professional, confident, and polished demeanor when interacting with clients, agents, and vendors

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, time-sensitive real estate environment

• Ability to work independently while maintaining clear, proactive communication and status updates

• Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus


Compensation & Perks

• R$4,000 per month (paid in Brazilian Reais)

• This is a remote position, compensated in BRL (R$)

• Opportunity for growth as the team and responsibilities expand

• Performance-based growth opportunities are available. Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed based on performance, consistency, and contribution to the team.

• Work Schedule (Eastern Time):

Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Tuesday and Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• Paid time off:

7 holidays

First year: 1 week of paid vacation

From the second year onward: 2 weeks of paid vacation

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.


Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. This critical data is the foundation for essential business processes, including personalized marketing, analytical reporting, and seamless online and in-store checkout and customer service experiences.


They manage a wide array of high-performance, scalable batch and real-time services. These services are utilized at numerous customer interactions, such as in-store purchases, online orders, rewards program enrollments, and activations from various marketing channels (Email, Direct Mail, SMS, Push notifications, etc.). By leveraging modern development practices, tools, and technology platforms, the CI team builds capabilities that empower customer-facing and checkout teams to deliver personalized, relevant, and frictionless experiences, ensuring customers realize value with every interaction.


Core hours:

This team operates in every major US time zone from Pacific to Eastern. Core hours would be considered 10 am CST - 4 pm CST with 2 hours spilling over either direction based on location.


Required Skills:

Non-Negotiable Requirements
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java, particularly Spring Boot.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.


Tech Stack:  Java, Springboot, Redis, Relational Database (MySQL, Oracle), NoSQL Database (Mongo), Kafka, Cloud engineering (Docker/Kubernetes), Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Testing framework (Junit, Jest).


Bonus Skills:

Experience with GCP suite (BigQuery), Airflow, and Web framework (Astro).


Duration:  3 months; end date being March 31, 2026, with the possibility of being extended based on team needs.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Performance Static Designer
description:
ReciMe is a recipe app revolutionizing how cooks organize, plan and shop their recipes. Our smart importing tool enables users to aggregate all their recipes in one platform within seconds - whether those recipes came from an Instagram video, recipe blog or grandma’s recipe box.


We’ve been a Top 10 app in the US App Store’s Food category for months and were recently featured on The Drew Barrymore Show.


Now, we’re looking for a Performance Static Designer to join our team!


You’ll be responsible for creating static and carousel ads for Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok and Pinterest.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your designs will play a key role in driving engagement, conversions, and brand growth.

title: \"Analista DevOps SR#984930\"
description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente do ramo do varejo.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em práticas DevSecOps e metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em construção de pipelines (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração CI/CD (Azure DevOps);
  • Experiência com sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows;
  • Experiência com sistemas containers;
  • Experiência em ferramentas e boas-práticas de infraestrutura como código (Terraform e Helm);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Github, Gitlab, entre outras);
  • Experiência com administração e provisionamento de recursos em nuvem pública (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality/Quality Gate como SonarCloud, Snyk, Gitleaks ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de integrações via API;
  • Conhecimento da ferramenta Backstage;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Conhecimento em processo de automação de testes;


Atuação 100% remoto - Brasil

Contratação CLT

Relacionamento com cliente e comunicação executiva

  • Apresentar resultados e recomendações com clareza, consistência e objetividade, incluindo riscos, trade-offs e plano de ação.
  • Conduzir reuniões semanais/mensais com foco em decisão, priorização e evolução contínua.
  • Preparar materiais executivos quando necessário, com narrativa e evidências.


Coordenação e padronização

  • Coordenar a rotina operacional e analítica, orientando analistas e/ou parceiros (internos e externos) quando aplicável.
  • Criar e manter padrões de trabalho: checklist de saúde de contas, modelos de análises, templates de fechamento mensal, documentação de testes e playbooks.



Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em mídia de performance com atuação avançada em pelo menos dois grandes ecossistemas (ex.: Google e Meta).
  • Experiência com e-commerce e indicadores de negócio (receita, margem, CAC, LTV, recorrência), com capacidade de conectar decisão de mídia a impacto.
  • Domínio de rotinas de otimização e estrutura de conta (campanhas, públicos/segmentações, keywords/negativas, criativos e oferta).
  • Conhecimento sólido de GA4 e familiaridade prática com Google Tag Manager (leitura/validação e diagnóstico de tracking).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado (organização e análise de dados; tabelas dinâmicas; funções e manipulação).
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal consistente, organização e autonomia para trabalho remoto.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência com BigQuery/SQL para análises exploratórias e validações de dados (mesmo que em nível intermediário).
  • Experiência com Looker/Looker Studio ou ferramentas similares de BI.
  • Vivência com metodologias de experimentação, incrementalidade e avaliação de impacto além de ROAS da plataforma
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação e materiais técnicos.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.
